rule_text.name: 702.293a
rule_text.rule: Resurface appears on some instants and sorceries. It represents two static abilities: one that functions while the card is in a player’s graveyard and another that functions while the card is on the stack. “Resurface [number]” means “You may cast this card from your graveyard if the resulting spell is an instant or sorcery spell by tapping one or more creatures you control with total power [number] or greater as an additional cost to cast it” and “If this spell was cast using its resurface ability, exile this card instead of putting it anywhere else any time it would leave the stack.” Casting a spell using its resurface ability follows the rules for paying additional costs in rules 601.2b and 601.2f–h.
